name: Gate 5B-4 Header Selection Event Fix
scope: Fix header-body column selection only; no Revo source modifications.
root_cause: The Gate 5B-4 selection bridge listened to the later headerclick event. Revo v4 exposes the interceptable original header interaction through beforeheaderclick, with the clicked column on detail.column.
behavior: Header body selects the currently visible rows only.
Filter and Sort buttons remain dedicated controls and do not select the column.
Filter, Sort, Edit, Paste, Dirty and Sheet History logic are otherwise unchanged.
